reason: Whitespace collapse is a supported configuration of XMLDocument parsing, but the old harness always selects PRESERVE_WHITESPACE. For ordinary text, COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE sets a flag that produces a distinct text value when read. The harness neither selects that mode nor reads the value. The same blocker exists before and after the change, so this is preexisting maintenance coverage, not a behavior introduced by g0001.
